goal: Deliver the approved bounded extent: durable attention identity and resolution.

starting_authority.release_authority: Founder execution authorization plus SWF-35; this packet does not itself transition status or launch a worker.

allowed_scope.extent: DONE/judgment events dedupe across restart; delivery failure retains a pending item and failed attempt; SEEN remains distinct from RESOLVED; wrong actor/revision/lane cannot resolve; DecisionInbox distinct; unbound activation launches zero models; preserve origin IDs/history/handler attribution; staged M-ATTENTION only.

sequence: snapshot source queue/history without retiring writer
stage aliases and attributed pending/seen/resolved history
compare producers/consumers before any separately authorized one-writer switchover
migration.rollback: retain source queue and aliases; stop new writer and reconcile pending effects

non_goals: retirement/replacement of existing protections or Factory Director Host cutover

acceptance.order: Implement only after pinning the fixture; run intact, each fault, restored, evidence generation, and narrow regressions; retain raw observations and independent verifier verdict separately.

candidate_custody.policy: Producer publishes exact candidate branch and full SHA before RESULT=VERIFY; fresh verifier retrieves it in a separate worktree; normal closure records LANDED, DISCARDED, or PARKED. No worker pushes main directly.

release_preconditions: fresh native Agent Ready READY against this exact work-unit and admission baseline
active profile readback binds AlienLogicLab/alienintent#78 with the allocation limits
all SWF-35 and release_admission checks pass
no active C1 claim and profile WIP permits it
GitHub Project status change generates the signed App webhook; Director does not launch a worker directly
stop_condition: hold on missing/bad predecessor receipt, profile binding mismatch, failed release gate, active claim, WIP refusal, unavailable proof evidence, or scope/authority change; preserve completed proof.
readiness: The earlier HOLD is superseded only by a fresh native assessment of this exact packet/work-unit input. READY is eligibility, not release.
